Description: Students enter ranked, eligible bids within their credit budget.
The registrar runs allocation and manages the ranked waitlist.
Students receive outcomes and the registrar manages exceptions with an audit trail.

As a student, I want to assign a unique rank to each choice so that the solver knows my preferences.
Acceptance criteria: Reject duplicate or missing ranks and preserve the displayed order on reload.
Traceability: FR-002

As a student, I want to see the credits remaining so that I can submit exactly 100 credits.
Acceptance criteria: Accept 60 + 40 and reject 60 + 41 or 60 + 39 without recording a bid.
Traceability: FR-001

As a student, I want to see unmet prerequisites before saving so that I can replace ineligible electives.
Acceptance criteria: Reject a choice with a missing prerequisite and identify the course that is missing.
Traceability: FR-001

As a student, I want to see clashes with my fixed timetable so that I bid on electives I can attend.
Acceptance criteria: For a one-minute overlap, show both courses and reject the bid. Accept adjacent slots.
Traceability: FR-003

As a academic registrar, I want to allocate seats from eligible ranked bids so that capacity and timetable rules are respected.
Acceptance criteria: Given one seat and two eligible bids, assign it once and log the deterministic tie-break.
Traceability: FR-001 / FR-003

As a student, I want to see my result after publication so that I know my allocated or waitlisted status.
Acceptance criteria: Show results only after publication and only to the student who owns them.
Traceability: FR-004

As a academic registrar, I want to reassign a vacated seat so that eligible waitlisted students can claim it.
Acceptance criteria: Skip an ineligible entry and allocate exactly once to the first eligible candidate.
Traceability: FR-004

As a student, I want to hear when I receive a freed seat so that I can adjust my schedule.
Acceptance criteria: Trigger one notification per promotion and record delivery within five minutes.
Traceability: FR-004

As a academic registrar, I want to override an exceptional allocation with a reason so that I can correct a roster transparently.
Acceptance criteria: Reject blank reasons and non-registrars. Save the correct roster and actor with a valid reason.
Traceability: FR-005

Summary: S10 Review the override audit trail
Description:
As a academic registrar, I want to retrieve a timestamped audit history so that I can investigate allocation disputes.
Acceptance criteria: Show the actor, reason, and previous and new roster values in under two seconds.
Traceability: NFR-002
